''See also: [[Doctor Cryce Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Doctor Janbell Cryce]] is a [[Lichborn woman]] characterized by her gray skin, unkempt black hair, and glowing green eyes. Often appearing exhausted or preoccupied with her laboratory work, she frequently operates in dimly lit environments and maintains a hurried manner of speaking. She is the inventor of the [[Divine Titans]] and has spent several weeks traveling with a group of companions. Her professional duties include repairing and inspecting advanced technology, such as the armor of [[Sola Kalter|Sola]] and the various [[Divine Titans]]. While she can be suspicious or blunt regarding personal reputations and family ties, she has demonstrated deep emotional responses, including grief and a desire to preserve the dignity of the deceased. Despite her intense focus on technical investigations and simulations, she maintains a level of trust in [[Raion Raithe|Raion]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|This woman possesses solid gray hair and green eyes that emit a glow in the dark. She also utilizes an [[ocular implant]].}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|A medical professional, she maintains trust in [[Raion Raithe|Raion]] and interacts with [[Jan]] and [[Kyri Prest|Kyri]]. She is the aunt of [[Parryl Cryce|Parryl]].}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Doctor [[Cryce]] is the aunt of [[Parryl Cryce|Parryl]]. She also interacts with [[Jan]] and [[Kyri Prest|Kyri]], maintains trust in [[Raion Raithe|Raion]], and is a person requested by the Captain.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|As a master [[Aether Technician]], she possesses [[Technicians|Technician]] gifts that are not used for biological modification. Her skills include managing infrastructure at the [[Titan Forge]], repairing the [[Red Divine Titan|Red Titan]], and inventing the [[Divine Titans]].}}
